t: r/swtor on Reddit: Is there any other way to get shadow silk other than the mission skill or do I have to get the skill on another character?
s: July 12, 2018 - If you're looking to fast track a crew skill to 600, I suggest just making the skill-specific mats as you're able to - these tend to cost least and push the skill the fastest (plus they don't take long to do), and chances are people will buy them for conquest supplies (making invasion force mats).

As alredy said, you can get the shadow wolf pelt in EC. Start by seeing if the Inns got some for sale. It will cost under 1pp there. If not, hunt the shadow wolf yourself (can take some time), or auction that you want to buy it.
